name: Open Legend · Gildmoss
status: Accepted design system for the interface overhaul; not yet integrated into the game.

color.note: Role names reuse the current tokens where the meaning is the same (canvas, surface, ink, highlight, focus, health, food, energy, danger), so integration can map Gildmoss onto existing semantic roles. Gold metal lives on what is chosen, rims and gold labels — never on panel borders or button fills. Everything unselected is silver.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Deepest olive: screen ground, sheet ground, the North mark's dark ring. Never a panel fill.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Opaque equivalent of the panel glass at its top; use only where blur is unavailable.

tokens.name: surface-glass
tokens.usage: Panels, windows, menus and tooltips: the top of the glass gradient, over a 12 px blur of the world.

tokens.name: surface-glass-hud
tokens.usage: HUD plates and the Say and Act bars over the world.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons and chips.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Button hover.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Chosen and hovered rows, tabs, toggles and hotbar tiles, under a gold metal edge.

tokens.name: surface-well
tokens.usage: Fields, segmented groups, sheet stages.

tokens.name: surface-slot
tokens.usage: A filled slot.

tokens.name: surface-slot-empty
tokens.usage: An empty slot, a ghost slot, an equipment slot.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Silver dividers and panel seams.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: The 1 px inset edge of buttons, fields and keyboard hints.

tokens.name: line-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered button, slot and tile edges.

tokens.name: line-gold-soft
tokens.usage: Faint gold lines.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Ivory text.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions and secondary text.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Hints, counts, labels in capitals.

tokens.name: ink-silver
tokens.usage: Unselected tabs, rows and icons.

tokens.name: ink-world
tokens.usage: Status lines over the world.

tokens.name: ink-world-name
tokens.usage: Names over the world and your marker on the minimap (light gold).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Polished champagne: the narrator's timer line, drop targets, a marked slot.

tokens.name: highlight-line
tokens.usage: Gold line colour where a flat gold is needed.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one primary button per panel and the quantity slider's fill — a solid gold.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed.

tokens.name: primary-edge
tokens.usage: The primary button's 1 px inset edge.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Dark ink on the gold primary button.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus: a 2 px outline 2 px outside buttons; a 1 px inset edge plus a 2 px 35 % halo on fields.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Coral: missing ingredients, unavailable reasons and red counts.

tokens.name: gain
tokens.usage: Leaf: net gain, have everything.

tokens.name: world-change
tokens.usage: Changes over the world, such as −3 Health: Figtree 700 15/20 with the world text shadow, rising and fading over a second.

tokens.name: health
tokens.usage: Health need bar (cadmium red deep), 3.6 : 1 on the track.

tokens.name: food
tokens.usage: Food need bar (cadmium yellow deep), 6.7 : 1; stays clear of the selection gold.

tokens.name: energy
tokens.usage: Energy need bar (permanent green), 4.6 : 1.

tokens.name: spirit
tokens.usage: Spirit need bar (cobalt), 3.4 : 1. Shown only when a world defines this need.

tokens.name: meter-track
tokens.usage: Need-bar track; every need colour is at least 3 : 1 against it.

tokens.name: status-good
tokens.usage: Good statuses: ring, lasting border.

tokens.name: status-bad
tokens.usage: Bad statuses.

tokens.name: status-neutral
tokens.usage: Neutral statuses.

tokens.name: status-special
tokens.usage: Special statuses.

tokens.name: status-ground
tokens.usage: Behind a status glyph inside its ring or square.

metal.note: Metal reflects; it does not glow. Gradients are copied exactly from the boards. icons/icons.css applies them to icons: gold when chosen, silver otherwise, ivory inside statuses, ink on the gold primary button, green for Have everything.

tokens.name: metal-gold-edge
tokens.usage: The 1 px ring on a chosen button, tab, row or tile and the 2 px ring on a selected slot, drawn as a masked border.

tokens.name: metal-gold-line
tokens.usage: The chosen tab's 2 px underline; vertically (180deg) the hotbar dividers, 1 × 40.

tokens.name: metal-gold-rim
tokens.usage: Round rims: the minimap (206 around a 200 map), the day-and-night dial (72 around 68) and the game-menu button (32 around 28).

tokens.name: metal-gold-label
tokens.usage: Gold label text (clipped to the text): chosen titles, ingredient labels.

tokens.name: metal-gold-icon
tokens.usage: Chosen icons; SVG id ol-metal-gold over y 3–21 of the 24 grid.

tokens.name: metal-silver-icon
tokens.usage: Unselected icons; SVG id ol-metal-silver.

tokens.name: metal-ivory-icon
tokens.usage: Status glyphs inside their ring or square; SVG id ol-metal-ivory.

tokens.name: metal-ink-icon
tokens.usage: Icons on the gold primary button; SVG id ol-metal-ink.

tokens.name: metal-green-icon
tokens.usage: The Have everything checks in Crafting; SVG id ol-metal-green.

tokens.name: icon-mark
tokens.usage: The dark engraved line inside a metal icon. The icon bodies read --icon-mark; this is also their default.

tokens.name: icon-mark-on-primary
tokens.usage: The engraved line on icons inside the gold primary button (class ol-icon--on-primary).

tokens.name: progress-fill
tokens.usage: Work progress: a smooth champagne fill, no tick marks.

tokens.name: north-mark
tokens.usage: The 20 px North mark on the minimap rim, with a 2 px canvas ring and a Gelasio 600 12 px N in #1A1204.

lantern.usage: Layered over the glass fill at the top of every panel, window, menu, tooltip and HUD plate. It turns amber and wider at night.

surface.border: Panels have no border: glass, blur, lantern light and shadow define them (on trial, Mike 2026-10-25).

shadow.name: shadow-plate
shadow.usage: HUD plates and the Say and Act bars.

shadow.name: shadow-rim
shadow.usage: The minimap rim; 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) for the dial.

night.note: As daylight falls at dusk the glow and the amber lantern light fade in; by day there is no glow. Subtle, wide and soft, like firelight.

glow.target: chosen button, tab, row, open or hovered menu row

families.name: Gelasio
families.role: Names and titles at 600 (500 for long names); in italic the narrator's captions. Never people's speech.

families.name: Figtree
families.role: Every label, row, button and number: 500 to read, 600 to act, 700 for labels.

roles.name: world-name
roles.usage: Names over the world, tooltip titles.

roles.name: label
roles.usage: Labels in capitals and counts; never smaller.

spacing.usage: Every padding, margin and gap uses this scale. CSS names each step by its multiple of 4 px, as the current client does: --space-1 4, --space-2 8, --space-3 12, --space-4 16, --space-6 24, --space-8 32.

statusTimed.ring: 2 px arc of the time left over a 1 px track at 30 % of the status colour; runs down clockwise from 12 o'clock

statusLasting.border: steady 2 px in the status colour

specialShine.use: Rewards, awards, achievements and special items only — never ordinary tabs, rows, slots, buttons, panels, menus or tooltips.
specialShine.edge: linear-gradient(180deg, #DAC898 0, #B9A26F calc(30% - min(16px, 20%)), #FFFAEE calc(30% - 4px), #FFFFF8 calc(30% - 1px), #FFFFF8 calc(30% + 1px), #FFFAEE calc(30% + 4px), #B9A26F calc(30% + min(16px, 20%)), #957F56 100%)
specialShine.width: 2 px border; two bright spots on opposite sides; no glow; no line inside the panel
specialShine.status: Reserved; no screen uses it yet.

narrator.line: Gelasio italic 400 20/28, ivory, centred, up to three lines
narrator.timer: 2 px #DBBE7C line 16 under the text, as wide as the text, shortening toward the centre
narrator.close: silver X only on hover, top right
narrator.reveal: word by word over about a second, held, then a half-second fade; with reduced motion it simply appears and disappears

eventsQuickView.button: bottom left, level with the hotbar
eventsQuickView.panel: from 24 off the left edge to 16 before the first hotbar slot (427 wide at 1920), 414 tall, replacing the button while open
eventsQuickView.row: time Figtree 600 12/20 muted 40 wide; kind icon 16 silver; line Figtree 500 14/20 ivory; 8 between rows; newest at the bottom

hotbar.order: ten slots · Speak, Act, Combat mode · Character, Journal, Crafting, Build, Game menu
hotbar.gameMenuButton: 40 × 40, the campfire seal in a 32 champagne rim

minimap.position: top-right corner: rim 24 from the right edge, North mark 24 from the top
minimap.zoom: round 28 buttons at the rim's lower left, 4 apart
minimap.place: Gelasio name centred under the minimap
minimap.night: the map picture dims with the night light; the rim, North mark, dial and text keep their colours

menu.row: 32 high, 4 from the panel side, content 12 from the edge
menu.lead: 18 icon in a 24 column, or the item's sprite at 1× in a 40 column
menu.header: object art in a 64 × 52 well, name Gelasio 17, state Figtree 13
menu.hoverAndOpen: chosen fill with a gold metal edge; open rows also gold label, count and chevron
menu.unavailable: muted label, art at 45 %, reason in coral beneath
menu.submenu: opens 4 px to the right, first row level with its parent (left only at the screen edge)

hudPlate.size: 284 wide, 24 from the top and left edges, padding 12, gap 8; HUD glass
hudPlate.portrait: a 64 × 64 button with radius 8 and ground #1A2416 holding your portrait sprite at 1×; it opens Character (C)
hudPlate.needs: per need: its 16 icon, a 128 × 6 bar and the number in Figtree 600 13/16, 24 wide and right-aligned; rows 16 high
hudPlate.statuses: timed statuses, then lasting effects, as 32 status icons beneath

switch.size: button 32 high with Figtree 500 13/16 silver label; track 28 × 16, radius 8, well #0A0F09 with the control edge

quantitySlider.track: 4 high, radius 2, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55) with a 1 px rgba(196, 201, 190, 0.18) inset edge
quantitySlider.handle: 16 round in primary gold, ringed 2 px canvas and 3 px rgba(208, 186, 133, 0.6)

statTile.size: 56 high in a 5-column grid, 4 apart, radius 6
statTile.rest: rgba(239, 232, 210, 0.04) with a 1 px silver divider edge; label in capitals (silver), value Figtree 600 20/24
statTile.raised: when gear or a condition raises it: rgba(122, 170, 92, 0.16) with a 1 px rgba(150, 200, 120, 0.4) edge
statTile.lowered: when lowered: the same treatment in the bad status tone (not drawn on the boards)

loadBars.weight: a 6-high bar filled linear-gradient(90deg, #8E9A80, #C9CFB9), with Weight in gold capitals and 18.4 / 40 kg
loadBars.packingLoad: in a bag window: a 6-high bar filled linear-gradient(90deg, #C5A663, #DBBE7C), Packing load label and 15 / 24

mapMarker.chip: 24 round, rgba(10, 15, 9, 0.86) with a 1 px rgba(208, 186, 133, 0.7) inset ring and 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); the marker icon inside
mapMarker.label: Figtree 600 13/18 in dark ink #2A2314 with a light halo: 0 0 2px rgba(255, 248, 228, 0.95), 0 0 6px rgba(255, 248, 228, 0.7)
mapMarker.selectedPlace: a 32 pin with drop shadows 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9) and 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)
mapMarker.you: your portrait in a 40 circle on #1A2416 inside a 48 metal-gold-rim ring

minimapContents.people: 8 round #F6F1E2 dots with a 2 px canvas ring
minimapContents.animals: 6 round #B8C29E dots with a 2 px canvas ring
minimapContents.edge: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 46%, rgba(10, 16, 9, 0) 55%, rgba(10, 16, 9, 0.45) 100%) over the map picture
minimapContents.north: a 20 round mark, metal north-mark gradient, 2 px canvas ring, Gelasio 600 12 N in #1A1204

worldAgent.yourMessage: padding 8 × 12, radius 8, the chosen fill with a 1 px line-gold-soft inset edge
worldAgent.agent: its replies sit beside a 32 round avatar on #141C11 with a silver divider edge, holding the World icon
worldAgent.proposal: a proposed change: 440 wide, padding 12, radius 8, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24) with the control edge, column gap 8; it waits for review
worldAgent.composer: a two-line field and a 40-high primary Ask button
worldAgent.chats: a side list of chats, like a chat app

gameMenu.header: 48 high: the campfire seal (32) in a 40 metal-gold-rim ring with 4 padding, then Game in Gelasio 600 20/24
gameMenu.rows: menu rows; owner and God mode entries grouped beneath their own labels

eventsButton.tile: a 52 hotbar tile at the bottom left, 24 from the left and bottom edges
eventsButton.icon: the Events icon at 26, silver; gold while the quick view is open (the tile is then replaced by the panel)

component.eventKinds: Each Events row marks its kind with a 16 silver icon: speech ui.speech, actions ui.act, observations ui.overview.

dial.note: The day-and-night dial: not a clock. Sunrise on the left, sunset on the right; a sun crosses the top half by day and a moon the bottom half by night, both clockwise. The left point is the world's dawn and the right point its dusk; each half spreads evenly over its own length.
dial.rim: 2 px metal-gold-rim around a 68 face; shadow 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45)
dial.position: in the gap at the minimap's upper left: top 24 from the screen edge, 27 clear of the minimap rim; day, year and time centred 8 below (Figtree 600 13, then Figtree 600 15, fixed-HUD text shadow)
dial.skyBlend: a 22.32-radius disc at the centre filled top-to-bottom #F0DCAD (8 %), #BA6A5A (50 %), #0E1D4A (92 %), masked by a white-to-transparent radial gradient (solid to 30 %)
dial.markers: icons/hud/hud-horizon-sunrise.svg and hud-horizon-sunset.svg, each 10 × 7, placed at x 13.5 and 48.5, y 30.5 of the 72 box: a half-sun (radius 2.3) on an 8-long horizon stroke in the rim metal, with a 0.6 px dark drop shadow.
dial.path: both ride 28 from the centre (6 inside the face)
dial.angle: clockwise from the top: day θ = 270° + 180° × (t − dawn) / (dusk − dawn); night θ = 90° + 180° × (t − dusk) / (24 h − dusk + dawn). In the bundled world 08:24 → sun 306°, 21:40 → moon 145°.
dial.example: Day 1 · Year 1 / 08:24 — Year is an example value until a world defines years.

motion.progress: continuous fill; interpolate between server updates
motion.worldChange: damage and changes over the world rise and fade over a second
motion.night: glow and amber lantern light fade in at dusk
motion.reducedMotion: no reveal, rise or fade animations; content simply appears and disappears
